name: Sukumizu Lover
source:
Main character is the advisor of the school swimming club, even though he can't swim. The school does not have its own swimming pool, so the two girl members need to go to a public pool in an extraterritorial area where morals and enforcement are very loose. The protagonist takes advantage of this situation.

[Edited from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
